- No frameworks.

Create a visually striking cinematic museum-night website.

- luxury museum after dark

- quiet mystery

- dark velvet / near-black background

04 — The Venue

The Old Gallery, Warsaw

A nineteenth-century picture gallery in the heart of the old town — stone stairs, tall doors, and rooms that hold the quiet of a hundred years of looking.

The Old Gallery

ul. Złota 12, 00-019 Warsaw, Poland

Getting there

Metro M2 to Świętokrzyska, then a 6-minute walk along Złota street. Trams 4, 15 and 35 stop at Plac Zawiszy, two minutes from the side entrance.

Parking

Limited evening parking in the courtyard (enter from Krucza street). We recommend public transport — the night ends at 02:00, and the last metro runs at 02:30.

Accessibility

Step-free entrance from Złota street, lifts to all floors, accessible restrooms on the ground floor. The hidden-room tour includes narrow stairs — an alternative route is available on request.

Cloakroom & bar

Free cloakroom in the foyer. A quiet wine bar in the East Gallery serves until 01:00.

05 — Tickets

Choose your night

Three passes, one unforgettable evening. Every pass includes the full program — the difference is how deep into the museum you go.

Night Pass

€29 / person

  • Entry after 19:00
  • Main exhibition access
  • Full program access
  • Midnight gallery walk
Recommended

Curator Pass

€59 / person

  • Everything in Night Pass
  • Hidden collection tour
  • Reserved artist talk seating
  • Curator's printed program

Patron Pass

€129 / person

  • Everything in Curator Pass
  • VIP lounge access
  • Signed event print
  • Priority entrance

06 — Questions

Before you come

No. This is a demonstration landing page — the checkout is a mock. Selecting a tier and confirming a reservation does not charge anything and does not create a real booking.

Yes. Doors open at 19:00 and the box office stays open until 23:00. Some program points — like the 20:00 Hidden Collection Tour — start promptly, so we recommend arriving early.

Photography without flash is welcome in the main galleries. During the Midnight Gallery Walk we ask you to put phones away completely — that hour belongs to the dark.

Yes — step-free entrance from Złota street, lifts to all floors and accessible restrooms on the ground floor. The hidden-room tour includes narrow stairs; an alternative route is available on request at the welcome desk.

Upgrades are possible at the box office on the night, subject to availability — Curator and Patron passes are limited. Downgrades are not available once the hidden collection tour has begun.

Click “Save to Calendar” in the hero section — it downloads an .ics file you can open in Google Calendar, Apple Calendar or Outlook. No account or backend needed.

Letters from the dark

Be first through the door

One quiet letter before each edition — program announcements, hidden-room previews and first access to tickets.

◆ARTIFACT

ARTIFACT: Museum Night — produced with The Old Gallery, Warsaw. Program curated by Dr. Helena Voss.
